services.name: Skippered Charter
services.desc: Skippered Sails and Private Lessons are a great way to sharpen your sailing skills or celebrate a special occasion with the guidance of an ASA Certified and USCG Licensed Captain. Depending on the goal for your time on the water, we will help you customize your skippered sail or private lesson to get the most out of your time on the water. Skippered Sails are leisurely San Francisco Bay cruises highlighting iconic sights such as the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz Island, and the San Francisco City Front.
